objective: Determine the candidate aliasing/overlap policy and ensure the disjoint contract is preserved.
observation: Obtain the future Ascend-C candidate source artifact and its interface documentation.
pass_condition: Pass iff the candidate states a disjoint-buffer requirement matching the source sample, or, if overlap support is claimed, the implementation performs source reads before any overlapping write and documents that guarantee.
setup: Inspect the candidate documentation and kernel read/write ordering; identify whether it requires source and odata to be disjoint or claims safe overlap support.
